# DSP golden files

Reference outputs for the processing stage described in `docs/PROCESSING.md`.
They are generated by the float64 reference in `python/eegpipe/dsp.py`:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m eegpipe.dsp_golden testdata/dsp
```

`python/tests/test_dsp.py` checks that the files equal a fresh run of the
generator, and `go/internal/dsp/dsp_test.go` checks the Go implementation
against them. Do not edit them by hand.

| File | Contents | Go tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| `decimation.json` | decimation factor, output rate and processability for 10 device shapes | exact |
| `coefficients.json` | second-order sections `[b0, b1, b2, a1, a2]` of low-pass, high-pass and notch designs | 1e-15 + 1e-12 × \|value\| |
| `bandpower.json` | band bins, an input window and its 5 band powers per channel, at 250 and 160 Hz | 1e-12 + 1e-9 × \|value\| |
| `chain.json` | the whole chain for two streams (1000 Hz with a gap at seq 100, and 160 Hz): per processed frame, its output samples and the features completed in it | outputs 1e-4 + 1e-5 × \|value\|; features 1e-3 + 1e-5 × \|value\| |

The chain inputs are not stored. Both sides compute them: channel c, global
sample i, t = i / rate:
`20 sin(2π·10·t + c) + 10 sin(2π·(14 + c)·t) + 5 sin(2π·60·t) + (c + 1)·((i mod 7) − 3)`,
rounded to float32.
